Header.title: Where Digital Meets Human
Header.paragraph: Avanti Insieme Consulting bridges the gap between hardware, software, and the people who use it — delivering end-to-end IT solutions that grow with your business, not just for the moment.

About.paragraph: At Avanti Insieme Consulting, 'Avanti Insieme' means 'Moving Forward Together' — and that's not just a name, it's our operating principle. We don't build one-off solutions and disappear. We become your long-term technology partner, invested in your success as much as our own.
listOfWhys: We believe your growth = our growth — our reputation is built on your results
We bridge digital, hardware, and human expertise under one roof — no handoffs, no gaps
Implementing automation wherever possible means more time for you to focus on your craft
We speak your language, not tech jargon — strategy and execution you can actually understand

CaseStudies.title: Rebuilding a 12-Location Dental Practice's Web Presence
CaseStudies.body: Coastal Ridge Dental Group had grown to twelve locations, but their website was still a single static page built in 2014. Patients couldn't book appointments online, location information was buried in PDFs, and the site failed basic accessibility checks. Avanti Insieme rebuilt the entire site from the ground up: a location-aware architecture, integrated online booking, and a content system the front-desk staff could update themselves. We ran the new build through full WCAG 2.1 AA testing before launch. Within the first quarter, online booking accounted for nearly a third of all new appointments, and the practice's search visibility improved dramatically as pages became indexable by location.

CaseStudies.title: Turning a Storefront-Only Retailer Into an Omnichannel Seller
CaseStudies.body: Northfield Outdoor Supply had two decades of loyal in-store customers but no way to sell online. We configured and customized an eCommerce platform around their existing inventory system, avoiding the double-entry chaos that sinks most retail launches. Custom product filtering for gear specs (weight, capacity, weather rating) was critical — off-the-shelf filtering wasn't built for outdoor equipment. We also built a click-and-collect flow so in-store staff could fulfill online orders during slow hours. The store launched three weeks ahead of the target hiking season, and shipping delays that plagued their previous DIY attempt disappeared entirely.

CaseStudies.title: Modernizing a Law Firm's Conference Rooms and Workstations
CaseStudies.body: Union Street Law Partners was running client meetings off a decade-old projector and laptops that took minutes to wake from sleep. We handled a full hardware refresh: new workstations for all associates, wall-mounted displays and conferencing systems in three meeting rooms, and a structured cabling cleanup that had been ignored since the office's last renovation. Every device was configured, security-hardened, and tested against the firm's existing case management software before we called the job done. The firm's IT-related support tickets dropped to nearly zero in the following months, and meeting setup time went from a scramble to a non-event.

CaseStudies.title: Giving a Nonprofit Control Over Its Own Content
CaseStudies.body: Harbor Arts Collective relied on a volunteer web developer who had since moved on, leaving them unable to update event listings or artist profiles without hiring outside help for every small change. We installed and customized a content management system tailored to their actual workflow — event submissions, artist bios, and a donation page that didn't look bolted-on. Staff training took a single afternoon. Since launch, the Collective's small staff has published over 80 events and updates entirely on their own, with zero developer intervention required.

CaseStudies.title: Replacing Sticky Notes and Spreadsheets With a Real CRM
CaseStudies.body: Ferro Metalworks' sales process lived across a shared spreadsheet, a few sticky notes, and whatever the sales lead remembered from the last call. Leads fell through constantly. We designed and deployed a CRM configured around their actual quoting and fabrication timeline, with automated follow-up reminders and a pipeline view the whole team could see at once. The rollout included migrating three years of historical customer data so nothing was lost in the transition. Sales follow-up time dropped from an average of eleven days to under two, and the team recovered several previously-lost accounts in the first month alone.

CaseStudies.title: Automating Tenant Support With a Purpose-Built Chatbot
CaseStudies.body: Bellwood Property Management's leasing office fielded the same maintenance and lease-renewal questions dozens of times a day, leaving little time for anything else. We implemented a chatbot trained specifically on their lease documents, maintenance procedures, and building-specific FAQs — not a generic bot bolted onto their site. It handles routine tenant questions instantly and routes anything genuinely complex to a human, with a clear handoff so no tenant feels stuck talking to a machine. Within two months, routine inquiry volume to the leasing office had dropped by more than half.

CaseStudies.title: From Broken Mobile Site to Same-Day Appointment Requests
CaseStudies.body: Ashgrove Veterinary Clinic's existing site was unreadable on mobile, and over 70% of their traffic was mobile. We rebuilt the site mobile-first, restructured the information so urgent-care contact details were never more than one tap away, and added a same-day appointment request form that fed directly into the clinic's scheduling inbox. We also cleaned up years of orphaned blog content that was actively hurting their search rankings. Mobile bounce rate dropped sharply within the first month, and the clinic began receiving same-day requests they simply hadn't been able to capture before.

results.label: of traffic now converts on mobile

CaseStudies.title: Outfitting a Community Theater With Modern AV
CaseStudies.body: Meridian Community Theater was running productions on mismatched, aging sound equipment held together with patience and duct tape. We designed and installed a full audio-visual system: a new mixing console, stage monitors, wireless mic systems, and a projection setup for multimedia productions — all specified around the venue's actual acoustics rather than a generic package. Volunteer stage crew were trained on the new systems ahead of the season opener. The theater's next three productions ran without a single audio dropout, a first in the venue's recent history.

results.label: unified AV system replacing 4 legacy setups

CaseStudies.title: Scaling a Subscription Coffee Business Beyond Spreadsheets
CaseStudies.body: Ridgeline Coffee Roasters had a loyal subscriber base but was managing recurring orders manually through a spreadsheet and manual charge runs — a process that was starting to break as they grew. We built out a proper subscription commerce flow: flexible delivery cadences, self-serve plan management for customers, and automated billing that didn't require anyone at Ridgeline to remember to run charges. We also integrated real-time roast-batch inventory so subscribers were never sent a listing that was actually out of stock. The switch eliminated billing errors entirely and freed up roughly ten hours a week previously spent on manual order management.
